name: Reconstruction
source:
A future world - where everything develops quickly and especially in Medicine. With just one pill, all the wounds will be healed immediately. And right now, you’re living in that amazing world. But ironically, your parents, they have disappeared for no reason. Only to make your life more difficult because you have to pay off the debt left by your parents. You thought everything was deadlocked. But with a glimpse of hope shining on you, you have been adopted by Cara and together you have paid back the amount owed. And many others will always help you when needed. And then, you realize… you have to live in a harsh world, not the wonderful one as many people think this is.

[From [url=https://eis-wagner.itch.io/reconstruction]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
未来的世界——一切都发展得很快，尤其是在医学领域。只需一颗丹药，所有的伤口立刻就痊愈了。现在，你生活在那个奇妙的世界里。但讽刺的是，你的父母，却无缘无故失踪了。只会让你的生活变得更加困难，因为你必须偿还父母留下的债务。你以为一切都陷入了僵局。但随着一丝希望的照耀，你被卡拉收养了，并且你们一起还清了所欠的金额。当你需要时，许多其他人将始终为你提供帮助。然后，你意识到……你必须生活在一个严酷的世界，而不是许多人认为的美好世界。

[来自[url=https://eis-wagner.itch.io/reconstruction]itch.io[/url]]
